# Corsair K95 RGB Platinum (1b1c:1b2d), firmware 3.29 / bootloader 3.03: on-board profile file system, packets of iCUE 5.
# One 64-byte packet per line: "> " host to device, "< " device to host. The GUIDs of the profiles are replaced
# with neutral ones (11 11 11 11 01 02 ..., 22 22 22 22 01 02 ...) and their cookies with 1; everything else is as iCUE sent
# and received it, the stale bytes of the shared reply buffer included. See devices/k95p.md.
